svg.title: DeskLab
svg.desc: DeskLab is an open-source GUI library for Python that gives developers direct control over the event loop. Check out the GitHub repository and consider contributing.

g.text: An open-source GUI library for Python that
gives you direct control over the event loop.
Without the extra abstraction layers of traditional
GUI frameworks, you get finer control over user
input, event handling and concurrent processing.

svg.text: Check out the GitHub repository and consider contributing!
